meta.title: Travel Companion — plan the trip, not just the ticket
meta.description: An AI travel companion for Indonesian travellers. Tell it your budget and the kind of trip you want; it finds destinations, checks real flight prices, and builds the itinerary.
meta.ogTitle: Plan the trip, not just the ticket
meta.ogDescription: Tell it your budget and the vibe. It finds destinations, checks real flight prices, and builds the itinerary.

hero.lead: Tell it your budget and the vibe. It finds destinations, checks real flight prices, and builds the itinerary.

commandBar.askPlaceholder: Where to? Just describe the trip…
commandBar.askHint: Write freely — English, Indonesian, or a mix.

flightForm.flexible: My dates are flexible — find me the cheapest
flightForm.messageFlexible: Find the cheapest flight from {origin} to {destination} between {start} and {end}{who}

inspiration.title: What kind of trip are you after?
inspiration.lead: Pick one and it searches straight away. These are not SEO category pages — every tile runs a real query against the curated destination data.
inspiration.budgetLead: The figures cover food, local transport, and a place to stay.
inspiration.messageBudget: Where can I go on {ceiling} a day?

deals.title: From {origin}, what does it cost?
deals.leadCold: We have no saved prices from this city yet. Pick one and we will look it up live.
deals.leadWarm: The cheapest one-way fares we found for {date}{age}. Not live prices — we cache them so this page does not call a provider every time it loads.
deals.clamped: We have no saved prices from {requested}, so these are from {served}.

demo.title: Four steps, from no idea to a calendar entry
demo.lead: Nothing is faked behind this demo — every screen below is part of the same app you have open right now.
demo.step1Title: Say where you want to go
demo.step1Body: Fill in the form or just type. Both enter the same engine — the form is not a shortcut, it calls exactly the same tool.
demo.step2Title: Get a real list of flights
demo.step2Body: Everything the provider returned, not just the cheapest. Prices from Amadeus and Google Flights, not guessed by a model.
demo.step3Body: Narrow by airline and time yourself, or ask the companion — it sees the same list that is on your screen.
demo.step4Body: A day-by-day itinerary that lands in your calendar and shares as a single link.
demo.mockQuery: “Jakarta to Bali, late September, two of us”
demo.mockReply: On it. Day 1 Seminyak, day 2 Ubud…

trust.title: We do not sell tickets. So we have no reason to push the expensive one.
trust.body1Before: A recommendation engine that also takes a booking fee has a conflict of interest, and this one does not. Its job is deciding
trust.body1After: — which city, which week, which flight — and then handing off to whoever sells it. It sits upstream of the OTA rather than being a smaller copy of one.
trust.body2: The honest consequence: when a price lookup fails, it says so. It never invents a number to keep the page looking full.

footer.note: Built by one person. Flight prices come from third-party providers and can change.

flights.flexibleHint: Still flexible on dates? Ask on the home page — the answer is a single cheapest date rather than a list, so it takes a different shape.
flights.verifyNote: check again on the seller's site before paying
flights.emptyBody: Try shifting the date a day or two, or use the flexible-dates option — the difference is often large.
flights.filteredOutBody: There are {total} flights on this route, but none of them match the filters you set.
flights.fastestNote: Fastest {duration} · we do not sell tickets, so we have no reason to float the expensive ones to the top.
flights.wrongDateTitle: These are not the dates you asked for
flights.wrongDateBody: You searched {requested}, but the data provider returned schedules for {actual}. The prices are real, just not for that date — do not decide on them without checking the seller's site.
flights.rateLimitedBody: Too many searches in a short window. Try again in a few minutes.
flights.providerDownBody: The data provider is unreachable. That is on their side, not your search.
flights.companionStillWorks: The companion still works — ask it about destinations, budgets, or the best time to go.

trip.title: Your trip
trip.itineraryEmpty: Not built yet. Just ask: “build me a 4-day itinerary”.
trip.emptyLead: This panel fills itself in as you talk — destination first, then dates, flights, and finally the itinerary.

tour.step1Body: Fill in the flight form, pick some inspiration, or just type. All three reach the same agent.
tour.step2Body: Switch modes here. The first is for a route you already know; the middle one is for when you do not.
tour.step3Body: Pick a vibe or a budget and get destinations that actually fit — not a category page.
tour.step4Body: A longer conversation about your plan, with a trip panel that fills itself in.
